book.kingdomsatwar.umbrer_chronicle.page:
THE CHRONICLE OF THE UMBRER

written down by Ilvaren, seer of the Glimmer Meadows

for those who come from the light
Before the seal, the world was one. We Umbrer lived in the valleys between light and dark – until Nyxar awoke, the dragon who devours light.
Six dragons stood against him. They could not slay him, but they locked him away – and with him this whole land – behind a seal. We stayed to guard him.
For centuries we have lived in eternal twilight. We build towers of shadow stone, grow duskgrain and trade in moonsilver. The shades that stalk between the trees are Nyxar's brood.
Now the seal is broken. Nyxar sleeps in his citadel, but he will wake. Wanderer from the light: gather nightsteel and abyssite. And never look away when a shadow looks at you.

chronicle.kingdomsatwar.chronicle.text:
This chronicle was written by the keepers of the seal, generation after generation. It tells of a circle of six monoliths not far from the heart of the world: the Seal Circle. It was there that the seal was once forged.

Seek out the circle. The pages themselves will show you the way.

chronicle.kingdomsatwar.crown.text:
The land has seen a hero who defeated dragons and passed through the gate of shadows. Only one thing remains: the crown.

Return home to your kingdom. Your people are waiting for you.

chronicle.kingdomsatwar.dragons.text:
At the Seal Circle, a monolith awaits the shard of each dragon. The dragons slumber in their lairs, each in its own land. None of them can be defeated alone – bring your army. The dragon compass will show you the way.

When a dragon falls, its egg and its seal shard remain. Bring the shard to its monolith.

chronicle.kingdomsatwar.kingdom.text:
You have arrived in a foreign land with little more than the clothes on your back. Yet this land is waiting for someone to unite it.

Plant a town banner to found your settlement. Coins buy you a builder, farmers and craftsmen – and every army begins at a recruitment table.
chronicle.kingdomsatwar.prolog.text:
When the world was young, the Shadow World broke forth from the depths. Six elemental dragons – fire, ice, lightning, nature, earth and water – stood against it and locked it away behind a seal. Ever since, each of them has carried a sixth of that seal in its heart.

But the burden changed them. Over the centuries the guardians themselves grew wild, and today they suffer no one near their lairs.
chronicle.kingdomsatwar.seal.text:
When the last shard came to rest in its monolith, the seal shattered. What the dragons kept locked away for an age now lies open: at the heart of the circle yawns the gate to the Shadow World.

No one knows what awaits you on the other side.

intro.kingdomsatwar.line1: Once, this world lay silent and untouched.
intro.kingdomsatwar.line2: Then the kingdoms rose – with walls of stone and towers that reached up to the clouds.
intro.kingdomsatwar.line3: But deep within the mountains, in volcanoes, ice and sea, the dragons awoke.
intro.kingdomsatwar.line4: Six kinds – born of fire, ice, lightning, nature, earth and water.
intro.kingdomsatwar.line5: Whoever finds their eggs and raises them with patience gains an ally mightier than any army.
intro.kingdomsatwar.line6: Deep below, rare ores lie waiting: Draconium, Aetherit, Konterit – the stuff that legends are forged from.
intro.kingdomsatwar.line7: Gather knights and soldiers around you, raise your castle and defend your land.
intro.kingdomsatwar.line8: The world is ready. The dragons are waiting.

profession.kingdomsatwar.builder.descrip: Builds every building of your settlement block by block from its blueprint. Needs no workshop.
